title: Scottish baby names
description:
I was able to locate a similar data source to the one you used for Scottish baby names. I was wondering if it might make sense to include those in the counts here as well since the package is called UK baby names.

Pro: Package is called ukbabynames so it makes sense to include Scottish names here as opposed to in a separate package.

Con: This will change past counts, hence making the package not backwards compatible. One approach is to include Scottish baby names as a separate data frame in the package, but then I'm worried the ukbabynames name will be misleading for the existing data frame.

If there is no desire to include those here, I'm happy to collect them in a separate package.
